items.title: Notes On Your Tasks
items.description: Write notes under any task. They stay as plain indented lines in your Markdown, and you can hide them from the task list.

items.title: Any Status You Use
items.description: Todosian now understands custom statuses such as - [X], - [/] or - [-]. Long-press a task to switch between open, done, and your own statuses.

items.title: Subfolders Included
items.description: Optionally show notes from subfolders, listed by their relative path. Hidden folders such as .obsidian stay skipped.

items.title: A Layout That Fits
items.description: Pick grid or list categories, compact todo rows, and the view Todosian opens on launch.

items.title: Quick Add, Your Way
items.description: Point the add-task widget at a file so it opens ready to type instead of asking for a note every time.

items.title: Focus & Sync Fixes
items.description: Daily Focus now counts tasks scheduled for today, and saving keeps your line endings and final newline intact.
